evals.name: neighborhood-safety-app
evals.prompt: We're launching a neighborhood safety app where users report 'suspicious activity' with location pins, photos, and descriptions visible to all users within 2 miles. Run a Worrystorming session — I need worry clusters around racial profiling, vigilantism, privacy, false reports, and community trust.
evals.expected_output: Worry clusters with specific concerns organized by theme, reframed as design values, with priority ranking and concrete design responses to top worries.

evals.name: ai-therapy-bot
evals.prompt: We're building an AI therapy chatbot that's free and available 24/7. Run a Worrystorming — what could go wrong with AI providing mental health support at scale? Cover clinical safety, data privacy, replacement of human connection, and liability.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive worry clusters covering clinical harm, false sense of treatment, crisis handling failures, data exploitation, and societal effects, reframed as design values.

evals.name: school-facial-recognition
evals.prompt: A school district wants to install facial recognition for attendance tracking and campus security. Worrystorm this — cover privacy, bias, normalization of surveillance for children, and the chilling effect on student behavior.
evals.expected_output: Worry clusters covering surveillance normalization, racial bias in recognition accuracy, chilling effects on student expression, data breach risks, and consent from minors.
